about: Final-phase [DIAG] unit records of every acolyte scenario (temperate, mild cold, deep arctic, dry heat, humid heat) from the 24 complete physiology-probe runs of #2944 (docs/archive/physiology_probe_flake_2944.md): 12 runs 'baseline' (probe revision a1ce85bb6624d9d607ff7186ecac7b96e82a8e94, run-NN of baseline/diag_all.json) and 12 runs 'viarunner' (probe revision cc8f031b03a8c0af9c386b7f491035f4899e6cba, run-NN.diag.jsonl), kept under ~/.local/state/synarchy/issue-2944/. Trimmed to the circulation rule's inputs and the engine's own reading ('circ'). The 120 temperate records are the 24 runs x 5 acolytes of the temperate scenario. Used by tools/test_physiology_probe.py to prove physiology_expectations.circulation_rule reproduces real engine values (cold, hot and shocked units included), and that the old circ-min-0.75 edge unit (constitution 0.6807, fat 0.369) is explained by the rule.
